meta.name: TA Graphic Design System — draft tokens
meta.lifecycle: documentation-first; tokens are not yet a tested production stylesheet

statuses.trial: provisional numeric example; do not hard-code as settled

meta.usage: Consumers must inspect status. Null indicates deliberately unresolved, not a default of zero. See DESIGN.md, IMAGERY.md and DECISIONS.md.

formalDescriptor.notes: Explicitly accepted February 2026; contextual Architecture / Computation / Research wording also appeared later.

studioSubBrand.notes: Owner preference stated Oct 12, 2026; not ratified spelling or registered brand. METOD was prior shortlist.

logomark.notes: Do not treat early orbit/bear studies as approved.

presentationModel.notes: TA/teodorandonov.com is personal umbrella (27 Sep decision, re-confirmed 12 Oct). Portfolio and Studio equal prominence, alongside Notes and Apps/Projects.

primaryRoutes.notes: Names/routes are working labels, not committed URLs. Portfolio and Studio have equal status; Notes/Apps are independently accessible.

spinOffModel.value: TA subsite first, independent domain/brand when mature
spinOffModel.notes: TA keeps a link/entry to separated venture; no domain is implied to exist.

stage02Preference.notes: Owner explicitly selected it as best direction 13 October 2026. Visual style selected; exact numerical tokens and final identity deliverables remain under development.

primaryFamily.notes: Latest font preference after bilingual English/Bulgarian comparison.

numericTypeScale.notes: Older 40/20/10px and 44/16/13px ramps are historical trials.

mode.notes: No warm hue/saturation in TA design surfaces; photography/art keeps original colors.

nearBlack.notes: Used in some brand imagery studies; not mandated as every UI text color.

blue.notes: May 2026 accent palette; use only deliberately.

diagramHueStudy.notes: For diagrammatic illustrations, not photos or all brand imagery.

grammar.notes: One atomic content payload per Object; Cards may nest.

referenceDesignWidthPx.notes: Reference canvas, not a CSS max-width.

baseUnitPxAtReference.notes: Derived from reference width/divisions; not a fixed universal pixel value.

defaultCardColumns.notes: Choose locally; older 4×4 grid was a trial.

cardPaddingU.notes: Refined Soft Precision proposal; previous 2u remains historical study.

cardRadiusU.notes: Soft/rounded aesthetic selected, exact 2.4u numerical radius not approved.

textObjectOwnDecorativeSurface.notes: Wrap in a surfaced Card instead.

sectionHeightRatio.notes: Can be authored for visual sections; 0.625 historical trial is not global.

containerRelativeUnits.notes: Use one coherent root/viewer sizing context.

mobileBehavior.notes: Reflow vs proportional miniaturization needs live usability tests.

typographicRoles.notes: Four-role hierarchy proposed in response to critique of inconsistent typography.

rhythmSpacingU.notes: Restrained recurrence, with 0.5u optical corrections where necessary.

value.B: soft/diffused grainy fields from the same modular source

rasterMorphology.value: occupied grid modules merged into continuous rounded orthogonal silhouettes

diffusionModes.notes: Both in research; do not assume one is final.

preferredDiffusionMode.notes: Proximity was recommended, but not fully ratified.

generatorControls.notes: Inventory directly requested for the single-HTML experiment; numeric ranges not settled.

exportFormats.notes: Vector artwork ideally exports SVG, soft field may rasterize.

preferredDataGranularity.value: one or a few JSON files grouped by broad type

renderer.value: shared Card/Object component model between website and visual editor

sourceOfTruthSilos.notes: Design system should not duplicate actual website content datasets.

library.notes: Consistent outline icon family for semantic illustrations; ISC license (some feather-derived icons MIT).

strokeWidth.notes: Lucide default is 2; proposed thinner house setting.

strokeAndCaps.value: outline, round caps and joins, currentColor grayscale

independentFromImageFamilies.notes: A glyph and B field remain distinct brand art systems.

family.value: Lucide outline symbols, unique per app
family.notes: Approved approach in 21 Oct 2026 discussion; default for newly deployed TA PWAs, reiterated 27 Oct.

provenance.notes: Notebook previously named Sketchbook; the icon assignment persisted.

sourcebook.notes: Lucide 1.61.0; sourcebook PWA icon assets and manifest implemented 27 Oct 2026 in teodor-andonov/261025-2132_sourcebook.

mindmap.notes: Lucide 1.61.0; connected nodes / freeform mind maps. Implemented in teodor-andonov/261019-1740_pwa-mindmap on 27 Oct 2026.

svgViewer.notes: Lucide 1.61.0; visual inspection. Implemented in teodor-andonov/ta-svg-viewer-261012 on 27 Oct 2026.

cadGraph.notes: Lucide 1.61.0; Python CAD dependencies and workflow graph. Implemented in teodor-andonov/ta-cad-graph-261012 on 27 Oct 2026.

visualStyle.notes: App family choice from 21 Oct. Static PWA exports require resolved colours; ~2px stroke on 24x24 coordinates.

referenceLucideVersion.notes: Version referenced in 21 Oct UI icon discussion; production build should pin a compatible tested release, not assume this is mandatory forever.

launcherTile.notes: Shared monochrome app launcher treatment confirmed via uploaded JSON on 27 Oct 2026. Platform-mask export intentionally uses full square background, own sizing and OS rounding.

packaging.notes: 27 Oct platform guidance, not a previously approved visual identity choice. See APP_ICONS.md.

defaultPreset.notes: User-approved shared icon style from TA Icon Studio settings JSON on 27 Oct 2026. Applies across different Lucide app symbols; preview/tool default, not yet deployed into PWA repositories. Canonical importable preset: presets/ta-app-icon-default.json.

appSpecificColor.notes: Optional per-app icon stroke or tile colour may be introduced later; keep family #333333 on #e6e6e6 for now.

maskableScaleLimitPercent.notes: Tool clamps regular 60% scale to 54% for maskable export safety; this is an implementation policy, not a replacement for the approved regular launcher scale.
